chunks: 2358 - Safwan narrated from Al-‘Ays ibn Al-Qasim, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about purchasing doves in Mecca and Medina. He said: “I do not like that anything be taken out from them.”

key_terms.الْعِيصِ: Al-‘Ays, the narrator from whom Safwan reports
key_terms.صَفْوَانُ: Safwan, the transmitter in the sanad

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about buying doves in Mecca and Medina and taking them out?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal discouragement regarding purchasing doves in Mecca and Medina when that would result in taking them out of those sacred precincts. It reflects the special sanctity of the two holy cities and a disapproval of removing what belongs to their protected environment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2358 - Safwan narrated from Al-'Ays ibn Al-Qasim, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about purchasing doves in Mecca and Medina.
Imam (as) said: "I do not like that anything be taken out from them."
